# Contract: CUS04 Component API

**Feature**: Emitir Orden de Abastecimiento (CUS04) | **Date**: 2026-08-09

Defines the component tree, props, styling, and testing rules for the CUS04
module. It **extends** the base contract
`specs/001-project-init/contracts/components.md`; every rule there also
applies here (props interfaces, JSDoc, tests, a11y, tokens, shadcn
primitives, fonts, forbidden patterns).

**Source reference**: prototype generated by Figma Make in `dump/CUS04`.

## Scope

Feature directory: `src/features/supply-orders/`.

- `components/` — presentational + orchestration components.
- `logic/` — domain types, pure calculation functions, formatters, and the
  data-access layer (TanStack Query hooks live in `logic/` as hooks).
- Primitives shared: `src/components/ui/` (shadcn).

## Primitives to add (shadcn, preset `radix-lyra`)

Run `npx shadcn add dialog radio-group badge table input label`. Do NOT
replace the existing `button`; the Make-generated
`dump/CUS04/src/components/ui/button.tsx` is NOT used.

## Status → token mapping

The Make prototype hardcodes `yellow-*` for `Pendiente`. Prohibited. Map
statuses to existing semantic tokens so light/dark stays consistent:

| Status      | Badge token                 | Dot   |
| ----------- | --------------------------- | ----- |
| `Emitida`   | `bg-primary/10 text-primary border-primary/20`            | `bg-primary`   |
| `Pendiente` | `bg-chart-4/10 text-chart-4 border-chart-4/20`            | `bg-chart-4`   |
| `Acordada`  | `bg-accent/10 text-accent border-accent/20`               | `bg-accent`    |
| `Entregada` | `bg-secondary/15 text-secondary border-secondary/20`      | `bg-secondary` |
| `Error`     | `bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border-destructive/20`| `bg-destructive` |

Badges always include text (never color alone). Implement with shadcn
`Badge` (or the exact badge classes above if `Badge` conflicts with the
preset).

## Component tree

```
SupplyOrdersPage              # page container: KPIs, filters, table, wizard trigger
├── KpiCard                   # single KPI tile (extracted from inline grid)
├── OrdersTable               # expandable history table
│   └── StatusBadge           # status pill (shared)
├── OrderFilters              # status filter pills + search input
└── WizardModal               # shadcn Dialog (Radix)
    ├── WizardProgress        # 4-step linear indicator
    ├── StepModality          # pick supply modality
    ├── StepConfigure         # configure quantities (per modality)
    ├── StepAssign            # assign supplier product per ingredient (Radix RadioGroup)
    ├── StepSummary           # grouped by supplier + costs
    └── StepDone              # emission + send-status result
```

## Props contracts

### `SupplyOrdersPage`
No props. Owns: wizard open state, active filter, search query. Server data
via hooks from `logic/` (TanStack Query): KPIs, history, preconditions.

### `KpiCard`
```ts
interface KpiCardProps {
  icon: Icon                       // Phosphor icon component
  label: string
  value: string                    // already formatted (e.g. "S/ 1,108")
  sub: string
  warn?: boolean                   // renders with destructive accent
}
```

### `OrdersTable`
```ts
interface OrdersTableProps {
  entries: HistoryEntry[]          // domain type from logic/types
  expanded: Set<string>            // groupIds expanded
  onToggleGroup: (groupId: string) => void
  emptyMessage?: string
}
```
Expand control MUST be a keyboard-operable element (`<button>` with
`aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`), NOT an `onClick` on `<tr>`. Use shadcn
`Table` primitives; wrap in a native semantic `caption` or `aria-label`.

### `StatusBadge`
```ts
interface StatusBadgeProps { status: OrderStatus }
```

### `OrderFilters`
```ts
interface OrderFiltersProps {
  statuses: readonly OrderStatus[]  // filterable statuses
  active: string
  onStatusChange: (status: string) => void
  query: string
  onQueryChange: (query: string) => void
}
```

### `WizardModal`
```ts
interface WizardModalProps { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void }
```
Built on Radix `Dialog` (shadcn). Header (title + close), progress, scrollable
body, fixed footer. Shared wizard state (step, modality, items, done
suppliers) lives here (local state) or in a feature store; pass down via
props.

### `WizardProgress`
```ts
interface WizardProgressProps { step: number }   // 1..4
```

### `StepModality`
```ts
interface StepModalityProps {
  onSelect: (m: Modality) => void
  initialModality?: Modality | null   // restored when returning to the step
}
```
A `useForm` with a zod schema (`modality: z.enum(['platillos','escasez','libre'])`).
Selection marks the field valid and calls `onSelect`.

### `StepConfigure`
```ts
interface StepConfigureProps {
  modality: Modality
  onNext: (items: OrderItem[]) => void
}
```
Renders the modality-specific input (dishes, shortage table, free quantities).
Uses `useForm` + a per-modality zod schema (at least one quantity > 0; step
0.5). `Continuar` is enabled only when the form is valid. On submit, sends the
modality configuration to the API layer (mock backend) via TanStack Query
(`useCalculateItems`) and receives the calculated `OrderItem[]`. The
calculation logic lives in the mock API, not in the component.

### `StepAssign`
```ts
interface StepAssignProps {
  items: OrderItem[]
  onUpdate: (items: OrderItem[]) => void
}
```
One **Radix RadioGroup** per ingredient (grouped by `RadioGroup.Root`), NOT
`role="radio"` on loose buttons. Uses `useForm` + zod (`each item has
selectedProduct`) so `Continuar` stays disabled until every item is assigned.
Warning text when items remain unassigned.

### `StepSummary`
```ts
interface StepSummaryProps {
  items: OrderItem[]
  onConfirm: () => void
}
```
Renders `groupBySupplier(items)` (pure) with per-supplier subtotal and grand
total. No non-null assertions: components MUST receive already-validated
items (`selectedProduct` present) or use narrowing/type guards.

### `StepDone`
```ts
interface StepDoneProps {
  orderCount: number
  supplierNames: string[]
  sendStatus: Record<string, 'sent' | 'error'>   // per-supplier
  onClose: () => void
}
```

## Form validation (zod + react-hook-form)

The form steps (`StepModality`, `StepConfigure`, `StepAssign`) use
`useForm` + a per-step zod schema with `zodResolver`
(`@hookform/resolvers/zod`). Rules:

- Schemas live next to their step (co-located `*.form.ts` in `components/`),
  exported for logic tests. Inferred types feed the step props.
- Validation state drives the per-step `Continuar` disabled/enabled logic
  (FR-004): modality chosen, ≥ 1 quantity > 0, every item assigned.
- Form/validation logic is **not** the domain calculation layer; the
  calculate*/emit functions stay in `logic/api/mock.ts` (backend simulation).
- Error messages are inline, associated with their control
  (`aria-describedby`), following WCAG 2.1 AA.

## logic/ module contract

- `types.ts` — domain types as in the prototype (Ingredient, Dish,
  SupplierProduct, OrderItem, OrderStatus, Modality, HistoryEntry, …),
  adjusted: no `!` usage; add `SendStatus` type.
- `api/` — data-access layer. **Simulates the backend** (no real API in this
  iteration). TanStack Query hooks: `useSupplyOrders()`, `useKpis()`,
  `useCatalog()`, `useCalculateItems()`, `useShortageItems()`,
  `useEmitOrders()` returning typed data and send-status per supplier.
  Loading/error/empty handled in components per FR-008.
- `api/mock.ts` — **backend simulation** (assumption: backend calculates).
  Pure, typed functions that compute the quantities per modality, exactly
  like the real backend is expected to:
  - `calculateDishItems(dishQtys: Record<string, number>): OrderItem[]`
  - `calculateShortageItems(ingredients: Ingredient[] = INGREDIENTS): OrderItem[]`
  - `buildFreeItems(quantities: Record<string, number>): OrderItem[]`
  - `calculate(request: CalculateRequest): OrderItem[]` (dispatch per modality)
  - `emitOrders(items: OrderItem[], options?): EmitResult` with a
    deterministic per-supplier send result.
  These are covered by logic tests and swap 1:1 for the real endpoints.
- `calculations.ts` — pure frontend helpers with logic tests (these DO stay
  on the client): `groupBySupplier(items): SupplierGroup[]` and
  `formatCurrency(n)` via `Intl.NumberFormat("es-PE", { style: "currency",
  currency: "PEN" })`.
- Seed data from the prototype is moved to `logic/__fixtures__/` (test
  fixtures and mock source), never imported into production components.

## Styling rules (delta over base contract)

- All classes from semantic tokens; no palette values (`yellow-*`,
  `bg-white`, etc.) and no emoji icons (use Phosphor, e.g. empty-state icon).
- Currency/number cells use `font-mono`; page headings use `font-sans`
  (Montserrat); the brand wordmark uses `font-serif` (Playfair Display).
- Radii: cards/inputs `rounded-lg`/`rounded-sm` per theme; buttons keep the
  preset `rounded-none` from the existing `Button`.
- Dark mode: `.dark` class + tokens; theme state not held in page-local
  `useState` (prefer an existing/theme store or context).

## a11y (delta over base contract)

- Dialog focus trap, `aria-modal`, labelled by its title (Radix).
- RadioGroups labelled per ingredient; selected state via `aria-checked`.
- Expandable rows: single control element per row, `aria-expanded` +
  `aria-controls`, keyboard operable.
- Empty/loading/error regions have `role="status"` / `role="alert"` where
  appropriate.
- Badges convey state with text + color, not color alone.

## Testing requirements

Per component (Vitest Browser Mode): rendering for each prop/state (loading,
empty, error, selected/unselected), keyboard interaction (expand row, radio
selection, dialog close), accessibility assertions. Logic tests (node): all
pure functions including boundary cases (empty dish selection, no shortage,
single vs multi supplier, decimals with step 0.5), plus the form schemas
(valid/invalid transitions that enable/disable `Continuar`).
